title: Backlog item
description: One backlog item without a team: the content of one item file. This is the target under the owner decisions of 2026-11-13; the code still writes the key body where this schema says description.

seq.description: The item's number in this repository, never reused. Default: the next free number. Set by: the CLI.

slug.description: The name an item is addressed by in every command. Default: the number and the title. Set by: the CLI.

name.description: A short title of the item. Default: none, always given. Set by: backlog new --title, backlog update --name.

team.description: The team that owns the item. Absent for an item without a team; an item that has it takes its fields from its team's item definition instead of the fields below. Set by: backlog team new, a rule of the team, backlog team migrate.

repository.description: The repository the item belongs to. Default: the repository of the folder. Set by: the CLI.

branch.description: The branch the item belongs to. Default: the branch of the caller. Set by: the CLI, backlog move.

created.description: When the item was created. Default: the time of creation. Set by: the CLI.

updated.description: When the item last changed. Default: the time of the last change. Set by: the CLI.

updated_by.description: Who changed the item last. Default: the agent named, else the user of the configuration. Set by: the CLI.

fields.description: The values of the item. A field that was never given is absent and reads as its default. A key not listed here is kept as it is.

status.description: Where the item is, a free word stored exactly as typed; the finished words are closed, done and archived. Default: pending. Set by: backlog new --status, backlog update --status, backlog update --claim and --release, backlog done.

objective.description: The result the item delivers, one line. Default: the title. Set by: backlog new --objective, backlog update --objective.

summary.description: Several sentences about what the item is for; it routes new work to the right item. Default: empty. Set by: backlog new --summary, backlog update --summary.

location.description: Free text: where the work is. Default: empty. Set by: backlog update --location.

commit.description: The commit the work has reached. Default: the commit of HEAD at creation. Set by: the CLI, backlog update --commit.

severity.description: A critical item is placed first. Default: normal. Set by: backlog new --severity, backlog update --severity.

owner.description: The agent working on the item; outside a team, the user the item belongs to. Default: the user of the configuration. Set by: the CLI, backlog update --claim and --release.

owned_since.description: When the agent took the item; empty while nobody holds it. Default: empty. Set by: the CLI. A time, or the empty text.

depends_on.description: The items that must be finished first. Default: empty list. Set by: backlog new --depends-on, backlog update --set-depends-on.

parent.description: The item this one was split from. Default: none. Set by: backlog new --split-from.

estimate_min.description: Minutes of work, a whole number. Default: empty. Set by: backlog new --estimate, backlog update --set-estimate.

complexity.description: low, medium or high. Default: empty. Set by: backlog new --complexity, backlog update --set-complexity.

layer.description: 1 to 5 or process. Default: empty. Set by: backlog new --layer, backlog update --set-layer.

chunk.description: Small pieces of work any member does between items. Default: empty. Set by: backlog new --chunk, backlog update --set-chunk.

size_score.description: A whole number that sizes the item. Default: empty. Set by: backlog update --size_score.

completed.description: When the item was closed. Default: empty. Set by: backlog done, backlog update --close. A time, or the empty text.

description.description: The description of the item, in markdown, and the records appended to it. Given at creation with backlog new --description.

history.description: One entry per command that changed the item.

session.description: The session id, or the empty text.

step.description: The command, or the step of a team's rules.

changes.description: One key per changed field, holding the value before and the value after.
